title: AquaTerra in June 2022: {count} drives and a first anniversary
description: AquaTerra in June 2022: {count} drives, two stray dog outings, a sapling drive, a basketball fundraiser and a party to mark the first year.
lede: In June 2022 AquaTerra ran {count} drives, against {count:month-2022-04} in April and {count:month-2022-03} in March. Two stray dog outings fed dogs in Kolkata, a sapling drive planted in the city, a basketball fundraiser brought teams together, and the month had a party for AquaTerra's first year.

sections.heading: dogs and trees, as usual
body: Tails and Treats 10.0 ran on 4 June with three volunteers and fed forty-five dogs. Tails and Treats 11.0 followed on 25 June, with seventy-five dogs fed, the larger of the two outings.

Grow Green 5.0 planted eighty-five saplings in Kolkata on 11 June, with a helping hand from Each One Plant One. It was the same kind of planting day as the April and March drives, and the regular series kept its shape.

sections.heading: a basketball fundraiser
body: Inception '22 was a fundraiser on 18 June in Kolkata. Forty volunteers ran a full basketball tournament, bringing several school and college teams together, and it was the largest team of the month.
AquaTerra's fundraisers and matches are covered on the [fundraising page](/impact/fundraising), which explains how the events support the welfare work.

sections.heading: the first anniversary
body: On 10 June, twenty-five volunteers gathered to mark AquaTerra's first year with a full retrospective celebration. The write-up describes a year of impact, chaos and heart, and all the love, laughs and loud AquaTerra energy of the day.
The celebration has no place name, unlike the drives around it, which all name Kolkata.

sections.heading: how June sat between April and July
body: June had {count} drives, April had {count:month-2022-04} and July had {count:month-2022-07}. There were no Earth Day workshops in June, and the dog outings and planting carried on as usual.
Every drive in June that names a place names Kolkata, so {topPlace} is the place for the whole month.

learnings: A quiet month still needs its regular work: two dog outings and a planting drive kept going in June 2022.
A first anniversary is a good moment to gather the team, and twenty-five volunteers came together for the party.
A fundraiser can be a sport and a team event at once: the basketball tournament drew several school and college teams.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in June 2022?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran {count} drives in June 2022: two stray dog feeding outings in Kolkata, a sapling planting drive, a basketball fundraiser and a party to mark the first year.
AquaTerra marked its first year with a party on 10 June 2022, attended by twenty-five volunteers who gathered for a full retrospective celebration. AquaTerra was founded in June 2021.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra hold a basketball fundraiser in 2022?
faqs.a: Yes. Inception '22 was a basketball fundraiser in Kolkata on 18 June 2022, run by forty volunteers with several school and college teams. You can read more about AquaTerra's fundraisers on the fundraising page.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra plant saplings in June 2022?
faqs.a: Grow Green 5.0 planted eighty-five saplings in Kolkata on 11 June 2022, with a helping hand from Each One Plant One.
